verified_behaviors: New admissions default to renewable protocol v2; absent input preserves canonical identity, explicit false and historical bindings retain v1 fixed deadlines.

Fresh nonce/sequence challenges use anchored 30-second windows and immutable hard ceilings. Original worker identity, dual guards, persistent reaper, supervisor and database participate in every renewal.

Authorization alone does not extend database expiry. Both original watchdog receipts, a live same-instance reaper confirmation and a second committed transaction are required before delivery to the supervisor.

A 38-second real gVisor command completed with four acknowledged renewals after logical disconnect. Completion occurred beyond its original database deadline and binds the latest output progress and original live process/IO seal.

Renewal cancellation, authority revocation and controller death do not replay execution or manufacture success. Original-FD writes are denied after controller loss; automatic drain recovery remains unavailable.

Authorization event failure rolls back the second grant. Acknowledgment event failure leaves two grants and one acknowledged database deadline; a physical seal may contain node sequence two but is accepted only as Unknown.
Hard expiry returned a verified LeaseExpired report and an accepted Unknown result; renewals never increase the original hard ceiling.

Freezing a private ext4 journal filesystem prevented persistence acknowledgments but did not block the kernel kill timer; the target cgroup was observed empty five milliseconds after the accepted deadline while still frozen.

Reaper restart reads validated renewal history; a corrupt head falls back to the original deadline. Replayed control commands, closed control, lost output acknowledgment and partial dual confirmation fail closed.

Independent SQL and SHA-256 checks verify authorization/ack histories, receipt identity, predecessor deadlines, output progress and accepted seals. Separate signed S3 GETs and fresh readonly JuiceFS clients verify bytes and absence of late writes.
experiment_notes: Used the authorized disposable QEMU fallback because no repo-sandbox targets were registered; VM 4 vCPU, 6 GiB RAM, 24 GiB overlay. Removed its disk, private credentials and state after collection.
Built a new supervisor OCI image for changed sandbox code; its exact digest and binary hash are recorded.

Initial database suites exposed old-schema fixture reads and missing synthetic Request.version fields. Corrected migration rollback helpers and historical raw-SQL assertions without weakening production validation. Final Store tests include six new immutable-policy and renewal-transaction cases.
Bazel lock regeneration required CARGO_BAZEL_ISOLATED=false with the existing offline cache. Cargo.lock changes only the local Store-to-watchdog edge; no external package versions changed.

The first node probe expected synchronous cgroup.kill completion. Corrected it to retry only the documented DrainTimeout until empty; final eight cases passed. The earlier failure is retained in the log.

The first complete execution attempt passed all legacy cases and renewable short execution, then its disconnect assertion compared volatile checked_at_ms. It now compares only lease identity, epoch, revision, state and expiry. No production rule changed; the failed attempt is retained. The final full run passed in 448.61 seconds.

Independent history collection initially used an ambiguous SQL USING join after several lease-bearing tables. Replaced it with an explicit original execution lease/epoch join; all eight histories then passed without relaxing assertions.

After the VM run, corrected only ArmedGuard documentation to state that dropping renewable control pipes causes termination. Exact source-hash comparison proves this is the only implementation-tree difference; affected manual binaries were rebuilt. An initial rebuild named a nonexistent node_test target; the corrected node_contracts_test build passed.
Full Cargo ran before a final test-only canonical-JSON hash helper correction; the complete Store Bazel target and all-target/all-feature Clippy passed after that correction.
limits: One Linux VM with isolated HTTP object transport; no production TLS, HA, cross-node, load, throughput, suspend/resume or power-loss certification.

Live control and same-instance reaper authority cannot be restored from journal JSON. Missing or racing journal evidence may conservatively terminate early and retain Unknown; no availability guarantee is claimed.
No client heartbeat extends an execution. Queue/setup retain their original deadline; immutable hard ceilings remain bounded by admitted command/start/credential/session policy.

Computer ready=false; public execution unsupported. Full lifecycle scheduling, automatic drain recovery, multi-node fencing, continuous output streaming, browser/ComputerView and T01-T43 product acceptance remain incomplete.
